title: OpenMDAO: NASA's Design Optimization Framework
description: OpenMDAO is NASA Glenn's open-source Python framework for multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO): it wires disciplinary analyses into one model and computes total derivatives so gradient optimizers can improve the whole system at once. Aircraft, propulsion, and trajectory problems are its home turf. Dymos and OpenAeroStruct are built on it.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Components: The Building Blocks
description: An OpenMDAO Component is one analysis with inputs, outputs, and optionally analytic partial derivatives: aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, cost. Components declare what they compute; the framework handles the rest. Good components are the foundation of good optimization.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Groups and the Model Tree
description: Components assemble into Groups forming a model tree — the full vehicle as nested subsystems. Groups manage connections: an output of one component feeds inputs of others. The tree mirrors engineering organization, which is why large teams can build one model.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Drivers: Optimizers and DOE
description: Drivers run the model: gradient optimizers (SLSQP, SNOPT), gradient-free methods, and design-of-experiments samplers. The driver asks for objectives and constraints; OpenMDAO supplies totals. Picking the right driver for the problem shape is a core skill.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Derivatives: The Secret Sauce
description: OpenMDAO's power is total derivatives computed efficiently — analytic partials chained by the chain rule, or the adjoint/unified derivatives method for many variables. Gradients make large optimization tractable: hundreds of variables, one derivative pass. Finite differences are the fallback nobody wants.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Couplings: When Disciplines Talk Back
description: Real systems are coupled: aerodynamics loads the structure, the structure deforms, the deformed shape changes aerodynamics. OpenMDAO solves coupled systems with nonlinear solvers (fixed-point, Newton) so the model converges before the optimizer trusts it. Unconverged couplings poison gradients.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Dymos: Trajectory Optimization
description: Dymos builds on OpenMDAO for optimal control — trajectories as optimization problems via collocation. Launch ascent, entry guidance, and aircraft climb profiles optimize directly. The same derivative machinery that sizes wings now flies trajectories.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: OpenAeroStruct: Wing Design
description: OpenAeroStruct couples aerodynamics and structures to optimize wings — the canonical OpenMDAO teaching example and a real research tool. Span, twist, and thickness trade induced drag against weight. Students learn MDO on wings before touching vehicles.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: pyCycle: Engine Cycle Analysis
description: pyCycle models gas-turbine engine cycles inside OpenMDAO so the engine optimizes together with the airframe — thermodynamics as components, on-design and off-design. Propulsion-airframe integration is MDO's classic payoff. The engine is no longer a fixed deck of numbers.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Scaling and the N2 Diagram
description: OpenMDAO's N2 diagram shows every component, connection, and derivative in the model — the map reviewers use to audit large optimizations. Scaling (normalizing variables) keeps optimizers healthy across mixed units. Big models are managed, not just built.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Gradient-Free Optimization
description: When derivatives are unavailable or the landscape is multimodal, gradient-free drivers — genetic algorithms, differential evolution — search broadly. They cost more function evaluations but need no smoothness. OpenMDAO hosts both families so the problem picks the tool.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Multiobjective Trades
description: Real design trades fuel against cost against noise — OpenMDAO explores Pareto fronts where no single optimum exists, only trade-offs. Decision-makers pick along the front with full knowledge. Optimization informs judgment; it does not replace it.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Surrogate Models
description: Surrogates (kriging, neural nets) stand in for expensive analyses inside the optimization loop, trained on a DOE sample and refined adaptively. They trade a little accuracy for orders of magnitude in speed. OpenMDAO's MetaModel makes swapping one in a one-line change.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Uncertainty Quantification
description: OpenMDAO workflows propagate uncertainty — manufacturing variation, model error — to robust optima that work across the distribution, not just at the nominal point. Robust design costs a little nominal performance for a lot of reliability. The math of margins, automated.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: The OpenMDAO Workflow End to End
description: Ladder-top OpenMDAO: build components, assemble the model tree, connect disciplines, converge couplings, pick a driver, supply derivatives, optimize, and read the Pareto trades. Fifteen rungs from single analyses to system-optimal design.
